purpose: Measure the achievable per-fold drawdown floor of the game itself, model-free, through the strict serial simulator on the stage-1 folds, to inform the G4 gate decision.

random_selection.note: one random candidate per decision minute; loses money on 2/5 folds

oracle_best_pnl.note: perfect foresight, never takes a loss -> $0 DD is unachievable upper bound

finding: Random no-skill trading has a mean per-fold drawdown of $7,827 (max $13,012) at ~2 trades/day. The approved G4 cap of $1,500 absolute is BELOW the drawdown floor of random noise in this game; no strategy that trades at the G7-required frequency can satisfy it. G4 as an absolute dollar figure is infeasible as specified.
